name: Cape Cod
summary: Seventy miles of dune, beach, and shingled village — Kennedy history, whale-rich waters, and Provincetown at the tip.

lodging.name: A shingled inn in Chatham or Provincetown
lodging.blurb: Chatham for classic Cape charm; P-town for the lively end of the peninsula.

foodMustTry.name: Fried clams & a lobster roll
foodMustTry.blurb: A roadside clam shack is the Cape Cod ritual.

foodMustTry.name: A P-town lobster dinner
foodMustTry.blurb: Fresh off the boat on the Provincetown waterfront.

days.label: Day 13 — Hyannis & Kennedy country
days.summary: The mid-Cape and the Kennedy legacy.

item.title: John F. Kennedy Hyannis Museum
item.blurb: The Kennedy family's summers on the Cape, steps from the compound in Hyannis Port.

item.title: Historic Sandwich & the boardwalk
item.blurb: The Cape's oldest town — glass museum, gristmill, and a long marsh boardwalk.

days.label: Day 14 — The National Seashore
days.summary: Forty miles of protected Atlantic shore.

item.title: Cape Cod National Seashore
item.blurb: Wild dune beaches, salt marsh, and cycling trails along the Atlantic — an unspoiled 40-mile stretch.

item.title: Nauset Light & Coast Guard Beach
item.blurb: The iconic red-and-white lighthouse above a dramatic bluff.

days.label: Day 15 — Provincetown
days.summary: The lively, artsy tip of the Cape and its whale-rich bay.

item.title: Provincetown whale watch
item.blurb: Stellwagen Bank is one of the best whale-watching grounds on the East Coast — humpbacks and finbacks feed close in.

item.title: Commercial Street & the Pilgrim Monument

location.name: Pilgrim Monument
location.address: 1 High Pole Hill Rd, Provincetown, MA

item.blurb: Climb the tallest all-granite tower in the U.S., then browse P-town's galleries and shops.

days.label: Day 16 — Free / Beach Day
days.summary: A true Cape day off — sand, a book, and a bike ride if you feel like it.

freeMenu.title: Cape Cod Rail Trail

location.name: Cape Cod Rail Trail
location.address: Cape Cod Rail Trail, Dennis, MA

freeMenu.blurb: A flat 25-mile bike path through cranberry bogs and pine woods.

freeMenu.title: Chatham village & lighthouse
freeMenu.blurb: Main Street shops and the seal-dotted beach below the light.

days.label: Day 17 — Ferry to the Islands
days.summary: Leave the car and take the fast ferry out to Nantucket.

commute.scenicNote: High-speed ferry from Hyannis; leave the car on the mainland and get around by bike and shuttle on-island.
